1978-06-02  9.1
New aircraft. Airworthiness certificate issued.
Pre-delivery inspection completed. All systems normal.
Cessna Aircraft Co.

1998-04-18  2101.5
Annual inspection.
1. Performed annual inspection IAW FAR 43 App. D. 2. Replaced left main tire. 3. Lubricated all controls. Aircraft returned to service.
R. Mitchell  A&P 2214467 IA

2011-08-22  3384.0
Annual inspection. AD compliance.
1. Annual inspection IAW FAR 43 App. D. 2. Complied with AD 2011-10-09 seat rail inspection — no wear beyond limits, next due in 100 hrs. 3. Replaced ELT battery.
D. Alvarez  A&P 3105582 IA

2019-03-12  3891.2
Avionics upgrade — see avionics log.
Removed King KX-155 NAV/COM. Installed Garmin GTN 650 GPS/NAV/COM per STC SA01714WI. Weight & balance amended, new equipment list issued. Form 337 filed.
SkyTech Avionics  CRS #ST4R881K

2024-05-01  4102.7
Transponder & altimeter certification.
Transponder tested and inspected IAW FAR 91.413 / Part 43 App. F. Altimeter/static system IAW 91.411 / App. E. Systems approved.
AeroCheck Instruments  CRS #AC2Y441L

2025-07-20  4168.3
Annual inspection.
1. Annual inspection IAW FAR 43 App. D. 2. Complied with AD 2011-10-09 seat rails — satisfactory. 3. Replaced vacuum pump filter. 4. Patched left wing fairing crack. Aircraft returned to service.
D. Alvarez  A&P 3105582 IA

2026-03-02  4205.8
Replaced landing light.
Replaced burned out landing light lamp (GE 4509) in L/H wing. Ops check good.
M. Torres  A&P 3667012

2026-07-18  4219.6
Annual inspection.
1. Annual inspection IAW FAR 43 App. D. 2. Complied with AD 2011-10-09 seat rails, no wear beyond limits. 3. ELT inspected IAW 91.207, battery exp 02/2027. 4. Replaced nose strut seals. Aircraft found airworthy and returned to service.
D. Alvarez  A&P 3105582 IA

2005-09-14  2803.0
Engine overhaul.
Lycoming O-320-H2AD overhauled to service limits by Signal Engines. Zero time SMOH. New Slick magnetos, harness, and plugs installed. Test run normal.
Signal Engines Inc.  CRS #SE9K204M

2024-11-02  4131.5
Oil change.
Drained oil, replaced filter (CH48110-1), serviced with 7 qts Phillips XC 20W-50 + CamGuard. Cut filter — no metal. Compressions 76/74/75/77 over 80.
M. Torres  A&P 3667012

2025-06-08  4172.1
Oil change.
Drained oil, new filter, 7 qts Phillips XC 20W-50. Oil sample sent to Blackstone — results normal. No leaks noted.
M. Torres  A&P 3667012

2025-10-11  4196.4
Oil change.
Drained oil, new filter CH48110-1, 7 qts Phillips XC 20W-50 + CamGuard. Cut filter, no metal.
M. Torres  A&P 3667012

2026-07-18  4219.6
Annual inspection, engine.
Inspected engine IAW FAR 43 App. D. Compressions 75/73/76/76 over 80. Cleaned, gapped and rotated plugs. Mags timed 25 BTC. No leaks.
D. Alvarez  A&P 3105582 IA

2010-04-30  3204.8
Propeller overhaul.
McCauley 1C160/DTM7557 overhauled by ProProp Services. New seals, blades dressed and balanced. Zero time SPOH.
ProProp Services  CRS #PP7Q118N

2025-07-20  4168.3
Annual inspection — propeller.
Inspected propeller and spinner IAW FAR 43 App. D. Minor nicks dressed. No cracks or oil leaks.
D. Alvarez  A&P 3105582 IA

2019-03-12  3891.2
GTN 650 installation.
Installed Garmin GTN 650 per STC SA01714WI: new tray, antenna (GA 35), wiring. Interfaced to existing GI 106A CDI. Ground and flight checked — normal.
SkyTech Avionics  CRS #ST4R881K

2023-02-11  4038.9
ELT battery replacement.
Replaced ELT battery (ACK E-04). New expiration: Feb 2027. Self-test normal, remote switch checked.
M. Torres  A&P 3667012
